name: Presentations
description: Create and inspect portable PPTX presentation artifacts.
instructions: Use write_pptx with a non-empty JSON array of slide objects containing title and body fields.
Keep one clear idea per slide and put separate body points on separate lines.
After creation, call read_office_document and verify slide order, every title, important figures, and final recommendations.
This capability creates clean text-based decks. Do not claim template fidelity, charts, animations, or existing-deck edits unless separately verified.
